title: Interfaces parity: OpenVPN + Pseudo-Ethernet + SSTP Client + Virtual-Ethernet + Tunnel + VTI + VXLAN editors
acceptance_criteria: Backend exposes scoped wrappers for `interfaces openvpn`, `interfaces pseudo-ethernet`, `interfaces sstpc`, `interfaces virtual-ethernet`, `interfaces tunnel`, `interfaces vti`, and `interfaces vxlan`.
UI includes dedicated form-first pages under Network Interfaces for OpenVPN, Pseudo-Ethernet, SSTP Client, Virtual-Ethernet, Tunnel, VTI, and VXLAN.
Each page supports create/read/update/delete using diff-based `set/delete` command generation with validation.
Sidebar navigation, Interfaces quick links, guides, and runtime smoke routes include all newly added interface pages.
Validation gates pass: backend wrapper tests, frontend typecheck, targeted eslint, frontend build, runtime smoke.
assumptions: OpenVPN interface parser currently models high-signal config leaves; advanced server-client nested objects (per-client maps, MFA subtrees) remain follow-up depth work.
Pseudo-Ethernet and Virtual-Ethernet pages currently focus on core interface/common fields and do not yet expose nested VLAN/QinQ editors.
Tunnel page currently covers core encapsulation/endpoints/common IP toggles and GRE key; advanced tunnel-specific options remain follow-up depth work.
VTI page currently covers baseline interface fields; deeper IPsec option coupling lives in VPN/IPsec workflows.
VXLAN page currently covers major transport and parameter options plus VLAN-to-VNI mappings; deeper EVPN/SVD integration verification remains follow-up work.
Playwright browser smoke remains environment-limited in this host due missing system shared libraries.

tasks.notes: OpenVPN interface editor implemented with mode/protocol/addressing/tls/encryption/server controls and diff-based saves.
Pseudo-Ethernet editor implemented with source-interface, common interface fields, and address CRUD.
SSTP client editor implemented with server/routing/ip settings and MSS controls.
Tunnel editor implemented for core encapsulation, endpoint, addressing, and key interface toggles.
Virtual-Ethernet editor implemented with peer-name pairing, common interface fields, and address CRUD.
VTI editor implemented with common interface fields and route-based VPN friendly baseline UX.
VXLAN editor implemented with unicast/multicast transport, parameters, and VLAN-to-VNI mapping support.
Expanded wrapper tests and smoke route sets for newly added interface pages; runtime smoke verified.
Next queued item: implement wireless interface coverage strategy with platform capability gating (`interfaces wireless`).
